name: International Standard Classification of Occupations 2008 (ISCO-08)
custodian: International Labour Organization Department of Statistics
concept_classified: occupation, defined as a set of jobs whose main tasks and duties have a high degree of similarity
statistical_unit: job or occupation under ISCO rules

temporal_validity.transition_note: ILO states ISCO-08 is the current version while a revision is underway; future revision must be a new edition, never silently substituted.

assignment_rules: Classify the kind of work performed according to tasks and duties.
Do not infer occupation from employer industry, employer product, legal form or organizational department.
Do not equate a free-text job title with an ISCO occupation without task/duty evidence.
Retain the exact ISCO edition used.
limitations: ISCO is an occupation classification, not an economic-activity, competency, profession-licensing, job-level or organization-role ontology.
National occupational classifications and regulated professional designations may require explicit crosswalks or extension packs.
The current ILO revision means future edition migration must be governed.

title: Skilled agricultural, forestry and fishery workers
Plant and machine operators, and assemblers
International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO)
claim: ILO identifies ISCO-08 as the current version and states ISCO organizes jobs into groups according to tasks and duties.
use_limit: Supports current-version and classification-purpose claims only; does not prove any individual job mapping.

title: ISCO-08 structure
claim: ISCO-08 has 10 major groups, 43 sub-major groups, 130 minor groups and 436 unit groups organized by skill level and specialization.
use_limit: Supports hierarchy and classification structure; does not establish coverage of specialist licensing or organization-specific roles.

title: ISCO FAQ and revision status
claim: ILO states ISCO-08 is the current version and its revision is underway with a Technical Working Group.
use_limit: Supports current revision status only; future edition content must not be anticipated.
